_note: Manual non-tradable list. score_factors_dual_door.py turns every entry into fct_veto='NOT_TRADABLE', which strips the quant band AND (via the existing veto guardrail) blocks the RS2/LLM overlay, so the name can never reach a ledger or a KIS order. This list is for names the exchange listing has not dropped yet — a halt or a pending merger that still shows as listed. Names that LEAVE the NASDAQ/NYSE/AMEX listing are caught automatically via last_listed and do not belong here. Removing an entry lets the name back in on the next chain run.
